edges.text: Replace @validator with @field_validator plus @classmethod, take info: ValidationInfo and read earlier fields from info.data instead of values.
Replace the field validator with @model_validator(mode='after') that reads and sets fields on self.

Replace the field validator with @model_validator(mode='after') that reads and sets fields on self.
Replace @root_validator with @model_validator; pre=True becomes mode='before' on a classmethod taking the raw dict, otherwise mode='after' on an instance method returning self.
Replace @root_validator with @model_validator(mode='before') on a classmethod that works on the input dict.

Remove Config.json_encoders; add @field_serializer for the affected fields (or a PlainSerializer in Annotated) that produces the same output, and move other Config keys to model_config = ConfigDict(...).
Remove json_encoders and add a @model_serializer(mode='wrap') that formats datetimes the same way.
Turn the __root__ model into a pydantic.RootModel[...] subclass and use .root instead of .__root__; parse with model_validate.
Replace the __root__ model with a TypeAdapter over the inner type plus a plain helper class.
Replace Model.update_forward_refs() with Model.model_rebuild().

Replace @validator with @field_validator plus @classmethod; pre=True becomes mode='before', each_item=True becomes validating the list items in the function, always=True becomes validate_default=True on the Field.
Move the check into an Annotated type with AfterValidator / BeforeValidator.
Replace @validate_arguments with @validate_call.
Rename removed config keys to their v2 names in model_config = ConfigDict(...) (allow_mutation=False->frozen=True, orm_mode->from_attributes, fields={...alias}->Field(alias=...)).
Replace @validator with @field_validator plus @classmethod, take info: ValidationInfo and read earlier fields from info.data instead of values.
Replace the field validator with @model_validator(mode='after') that reads and sets fields on self.

Replace the deprecated `__get_validators__` method with `__get_pydantic_core_schema__(cls, source_type, handler)` that returns `core_schema.no_info_after_validator_function(cls.validate, handler(str))`; import `core_schema` from `pydantic_core` and keep the existing normalization and validation in `validate`.

Replace the `PostCode(str)` class with a `PostCode = Annotated[str, AfterValidator(validate_post_code)]` alias. Implement `validate_post_code` to normalize spaces and case, reject values that are not exactly five digits, and return the normalized string; import `Annotated` and `AfterValidator` from `typing` and `pydantic` respectively.
Rename removed config keys to their v2 names in model_config = ConfigDict(...) (allow_mutation=False->frozen=True, orm_mode->from_attributes, fields={...alias}->Field(alias=...)).
Replace Model.parse_obj(data) with Model.model_validate(data).
Replace Model.parse_obj(data) with Model(**data).
Replace Model.parse_raw(body) with Model.model_validate_json(body).
Replace Model.parse_raw(body) with Model.model_validate(json.loads(body)).
Replace Model.parse_obj(data) with Model.model_validate(data).
Replace Model.parse_obj(data) with Model(**data).
Replace Model.schema() with Model.model_json_schema().
Replace .copy(update=...) with .model_copy(update=...).
Replace .copy(update=...) with Model(**{**obj.model_dump(), **update}).
Replace Model.__fields__ with Model.model_fields; field.required becomes field.is_required(), outer_type_ becomes annotation.
Set model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True) and replace Model.from_orm(obj) with Model.model_validate(obj).
Replace Model.construct(**data) with Model.model_construct(**data).
Replace .dict(...) with .model_dump(...), keeping the same keyword arguments.
Replace .dict() with dict(obj) and filter keys by hand.
Import Annotated and Field, then declare key as Annotated[Union[int, str], Field(union_mode="left_to_right")]. This makes Pydantic try int first, coercing "42" to 42 before considering str.

Add a @field_validator("key", mode="before") that converts a string to int when it represents an integer, and otherwise returns it unchanged. This explicitly normalizes numeric strings while preserving nonnumeric strings.
Add `model_config = ConfigDict(coerce_numbers_to_str=True)` to `Label` (import `ConfigDict` from `pydantic`) so numeric `sku` values are accepted as strings.
Add a `@field_validator("sku", mode="before")` that converts integer inputs to `str` and returns other inputs unchanged (import `field_validator` from `pydantic`).
In `from_sensor`, convert the reading with `int(reading)` when constructing `StockLevel`, so fractional sensor values are truncated before integer validation.
Add a `@field_validator("units", mode="before")` to `StockLevel` that returns `int(value)` for numeric inputs, truncating fractional readings before Pydantic validates the integer field.
Replace the `parse_obj_as` import with `TypeAdapter` and return `TypeAdapter(List[User]).validate_python(rows)` from `load_users`.
Remove the `parse_obj_as` import and return `[User.model_validate(row) for row in rows]` from `load_users`.

In `changed_fields`, dump the parsed model with `model_dump(exclude_unset=True)` and return the sorted keys of that dictionary; this preserves explicitly supplied fields whose value is `None`.

Import `field_serializer` from Pydantic and add a `@field_serializer("price", when_used="json")` method on `Quote` that returns `float(value)`. This makes `model_dump(mode="json")` emit a JSON number while keeping `price` as a `Decimal` in the model.
Change `Quote.price` from `Decimal` to `float`, removing the `Decimal` import. Then `model_dump(mode="json")` emits `price` as a JSON number.

Add a Pydantic v2 `@field_serializer("started", when_used="json")` method on `Shift` that returns `value.isoformat()`. This serializes UTC offsets as `+00:00` instead of `Z`.

Add a Pydantic v2 wrap-mode `@model_serializer` on `Shift`. Call the handler to get the serialized mapping, replace its `started` value with `self.started.isoformat()`, and return the mapping so `to_wire` emits the `+00:00` offset.
Import `field_serializer` from `pydantic` and add a serializer to `AuditEntry` for `at` that returns `value.date().isoformat()`, so `model_dump_json()` emits `2024-05-06`.
Add a wrap-mode `model_serializer` to `AuditEntry` that calls the provided handler, replaces the resulting `at` value with `self.at.date().isoformat()`, and returns the updated data.
